Wii teardown images are real4032x3024 but show the open battery bay, not a swinging gesture or the two strap diameters; they are not assigned merely because they depict a Wii Remote.

The Left Alive PC gallery contains a mix of800x450,1280x720 and1920x1080 sources. Large shots0/3 show mechs, and5 is too distant to demonstrate character equipment clearly; no false character-process assignment.
Shinkawa personal portrait art is not the Naora birthday image, as the source explicitly warns; it is not used.
